target_customer: Product and engineering teams at companies building production LLM applications (later enterprises and operations teams; in 2026 consumers for a personal assistant)
problem: Teams struggled to prompt, evaluate, version and deploy LLM features reliably. Vellum offered a platform for prompt engineering, evaluation and workflow orchestration.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscriptions with enterprise plans; consumer subscriptions for the 2026 assistant

founders.name: Akash Sharma
founders.background_notes: Per YC page; the founders worked together at Dover for 2+ years building production LLM apps. Education not found.

technical_complexity.rationale: Prompt versioning, evaluation, and workflow tooling across multiple model providers is standard SaaS engineering with some hard reliability parts.

defensibility.rationale: Many similar tools (PromptLayer, LangSmith, Humanloop) emerged; deeper enterprise deployment and compliance added some lock-in later.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Rival Humanloop was reportedly wound down in 2025 with its team joining Anthropic, per search coverage that conflicts on details; Vellum kept growing to a Series A in July 2025.

market_need_then: After ChatGPT in late 2022, companies needed tooling to move LLM prototypes into production; the founders had built such apps at Dover.

identity.logo: Brand guide with organic morphing blob shapes (Blob, Cloud, Ghost, Grump, Spiky, Sprout)
identity.visual_style: 2025 rebrand with wave patterns and linework, soft shapes, calming blues and purples
identity.voice_and_tone: Clear messaging about simplifying AI development; first-person friendly tone on the 2026 assistant page

branding.brand_signature: Morphing blob brand shapes and the wave linework

rebrands.to: Reintroduced Vellum brand with new visuals and swag
rebrands.why: Company says it wanted to reflect flow and precision of AI development as it moved to enterprise

branding.community_and_virality: Branded swag (T-shirts, notebooks, water bottles, stickers) announced with the Oct 2024 rebrand; first dedicated designer hired, agency Slope.

brand_strength.rationale: Invested in a distinct design system and swag, and public branding guide; no evidence of brand-driven growth.

pivots.why: Company site now leads with a personal assistant; reason not found

pivots.to: Shutdown of the hosted assistant, effective 2026-11-02
pivots.why: Company stated it could not grow distribution enough and competition grew fierce, per its notice as reported by a mirror site

outcome_analysis: Vellum rode the 2023 LLM tooling wave, kept going through a crowded LLMOps market and raised a $20M Series A in July 2025 on enterprise compliance offerings. In 2026 it shifted to a personal assistant and then announced the hosted assistant would close in November 2026 for weak distribution and fierce competition, so the company's current direction is unsettled.
notes: Directory status is Active; exit left as none because only the hosted assistant product is closing, not the company. Shutdown details come from a third-party mirror quoting Vellum's notice, not verified at vellum.ai. PitchBook lists a 500K accelerator round Jan 2023, one source only, unverified. A 25M figure in one 2026 aggregator conflicts with 20M and is treated as a likely misreport. The Why the name Vellum section was not retrievable. No dated 2023 competitor sources found; list empty. Failure factors left empty because the company is active; the assistant shutdown reasons are in outcome_analysis and pivots.
